module origen_069061(
    input CLK_5M,
    inout sda,
    output reg SCK,
    output reg [15:0] data,
    output reg output_light,
    input reset
);

parameter addr = 8'b10010000;
parameter w_adder = 7'b1010000;
parameter r_adder = 7'b1010001;

reg [15:0] num;
reg CLK;
reg [4:0] state;
reg [23:0] receive;
reg [1:0] sda_r;
wire sda_negedge;
reg sendstate;
reg pp_1, pp_2;
reg sda_out;

always @(posedge CLK_5M or negedge reset) begin
    if (!reset) begin
        num <= 16'd0;
        CLK <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
        if (num == 16'd4) begin
            num <= 16'd0;
            CLK <= ~CLK;
        end else begin
            num <= num + 1'b1;
        end
    end
end

always @(posedge CLK or negedge reset) begin
    if (!reset) begin
        sda_r <= 2'b11;
    end else begin
        sda_r <= {sda_r[0], sda};
    end
end

assign sda_negedge = (sda_r == 2'b10);

always @(posedge CLK or negedge reset) begin
    if (!reset) begin
        state <= 5'b10111;
        sendstate <= 1'b0;
        SCK <= 1'b1;
        pp_1 <= 1'b0;
        pp_2 <= 1'b0;
        receive <= 24'd0;
        data <= 16'd0;
    end else begin
        if (sda_negedge && !sendstate) begin
            sendstate <= 1'b1;
            state <= 5'b10111;
        end else if (sendstate) begin
            if (state == 5'd0) begin
                sendstate <= 1'b0;
                data <= receive[23:8];
            end else begin
                state <= state - 1'b1;
            end
            
            if (state[0] == 1'b0) begin
                SCK <= 1'b0;
                pp_1 <= 1'b1;
            end else begin
                if (pp_1) begin
                    receive <= {receive[22:0], sda};
                    pp_1 <= 1'b0;
                end
                SCK <= 1'b1;
                pp_2 <= 1'b1;
            end
            
            if (pp_2) begin
                pp_2 <= 1'b0;
            end
        end
    end
end

assign sda = (sda_out) ? 1'bz : 1'b0;

always @(posedge CLK or negedge reset) begin
    if (!reset) begin
        output_light <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
        output_light <= SCK;
    end
end

endmodule
